title: Case 030: A high-value shipment lacks an accessible proof-of-delivery record

details.data: Entirely synthetic; English; fictional geography; all times UTC

context: The recipient confirms receipt of a high-value camera accessory, but the order view lacks the handover record. Carrier support may release a redacted inline record to this verified recipient.
initial_request: I did receive the camera accessory. Please obtain the matching handover record so I can reconcile the delivery time in my order history.
overview: The escalation snapshot comprises history events 001–002. Event 003 records the next agent action; the subsequent events provide the disclosed calibration follow-through. Facts learned later must not be used as if already known at escalation.

next_action.summary: Request the permitted handover record from carrier support.
next_action.recipient: Secure shipment support, Plover Arc Logistics

outcome: The carrier supplies the matching record and the verified recipient confirms the recorded handover; no document is treated as universal proof by itself.
boundaries: Record and recipient acknowledgement support this handover only; neither proves contents quality or all future disputes.
